prompts.name: start
prompts.description: Orient and start working in this project.
prompts.body:
You are working in **@Pens/ffs-diff** (`cli`, `javascript`).

First call `ffs_overview` — it is the canonical map of this server's tools, plugins and a `recommendedNextAction`. Follow the recommendation.

## Project shape

- Type: `cli`
- Framework: _(none detected)_
- Monorepo tool: _(none)_
- Test runner: `bun`
- Package manager: `unknown`

## Quality gates

- `test` → `bun test tests/`

## When you change the project

1. Re-run `ffs_analyze_project` to refresh the analysis.
2. If the project grew (new scripts, new framework deps, new monorepo packages), call `ffs_plan_mcp_project` to refresh the blueprint and `ffs_create_project` to materialise the new tools.
3. Never invent tool names; only call what `overview` lists.

prompts.name: fix quality
prompts.description: Run the gates and fix what fails.
prompts.body:
Run the project quality gates in this order and fix what fails:
1. `test` → `bun test tests/`

If a gate is broken because of an external dep (downstream service, network, missing env), record it as `external-gate-blocker` with the evidence and continue.
